analysis.title: Rocket Launch Tracker (Space Technology)
key_insights: Global launch activity in October 2026 was 21 missions, versus 27 in September 2026 and 27 in October 2025. All attempts were successful.
SpaceX contributed 11 launches in October (one Falcon Heavy, the rest Falcon 9), versus 8 in September 2026 and 16 in October 2025.
Two of SpaceX's 11 launches were ISS related: Crew-13 (four crew members) and CRS-35 (commercial resupply).
Rocket Lab flew only 1 Electron launch in October, down from 4 in September.
Other active launchers in October were CASC (4 launches), ISRO, Galactic Energy, LandSpace, Mitsubishi Heavy (JAXA) and Korea Aerospace Institute.
DB expects Starship Flight 15 later in November, where management expects to attempt a catch/recovery of the second stage (Ship), which DB calls a critical milestone for the program.
